title: The State of Independent Med Spa Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent med spa websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/medspa/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent med spas, cosmetic dermatology practices, laser clinics and injector-led boutiques
findings: Only 34% of the 194 independent med spa and aesthetic clinic websites we scanned show any treatment price: per unit, per syringe, per session or a starting price.
A typical site answers five of the nine questions clients ask before choosing (mean 5.1).
The median overall score is 75 out of 100 (mean 75).
The least-answered questions are "What will it cost?" (34%), "Is it safe, and how long will I look treated?" (42%) and "Is a doctor overseeing this?" (44%).
The best-answered are "Can I book without calling?" (87%) and "Who will be doing my treatment?" (71%).
Injector-led boutiques and aesthetic nurse practices have the highest median score (76), against 75 for independent med spas, 75 for laser and skin clinics and 74 for cosmetic dermatology.
77% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
59% fail "MedicalBusiness, MedicalClinic, Physician or DaySpa structured data" (Schema.org · MedicalBusiness).

segments.name: Injector-led boutiques and aesthetic nurse practices

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme: pale taupe on cream and white on photographs are the usual failures.
agencyProblems.pitch: The soft palette makes parts of the site hard to read, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero video or image and the gallery, defer booking and chat scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on the phone where clients compare you with two other practices.

agencyProblems.label: A treatment price or a "from" price shown
agencyProblems.question: What will it cost?
agencyProblems.fix: Publish the price the practice already quotes on the phone: neurotoxin per unit, filler per syringe, laser and facials per session or package, or a "from" price for each treatment.
agencyProblems.pitch: The first thing a client wants to know is what it costs, and your site makes her book a consultation to find out.

agencyProblems.label: MedicalBusiness, MedicalClinic, Physician or DaySpa structured data
agencyProblems.fix: Add MedicalBusiness (or MedicalClinic or DaySpa) structured data with the address, phone, hours and the physician.
agencyProblems.pitch: Search engines and assistants have to guess what kind of practice you are and where you are.

agencyProblems.label: Downtime, recovery or side effects explained
agencyProblems.question: Is it safe, and how long will I look treated?
agencyProblems.fix: On each treatment page, say how long the treatment takes, the usual downtime and the common side effects, and link the aftercare instructions.
agencyProblems.pitch: Clients plan treatments around work and events. Your site never says how long they will look treated.
